GOVERNMENT SUPPORT · CHECKED 14 OCTOBER 2026

Know what support applies.

Electric two-wheelers

PM E-DRIVE support for registered e-two-wheelers extends to 31 March 2028. Only eligible approved models with advanced batteries qualify, subject to the ₹1.5 lakh ex-factory price ceiling, e-voucher process, registration and remaining scheme funds. The cap is the lowest of ₹2,500/kWh, ₹5,000 or 15% of ex-factory price.

Have the dealer verify the exact variant and show the benefit on the invoice. A published ex-showroom price may already include it: do not subtract it twice.

Cars and commercial autos

PM E-DRIVE does not provide a private electric-car purchase incentive. State benefits are separate. The L5 electric three-wheeler incentive closed for new registrations from 26 December 2025; the separate low-speed e-rickshaw/e-cart category has different rules.

Road-tax exemption is not the same as a cash purchase subsidy. Select your registration city in the on-road estimator to see the checked tax position. State quotas, buyer eligibility and funding still need confirmation.
